title: Low blood sugar
plain: Your blood sugar is dangerously low. Fast sugar first, then check it is working.

steps.question: Can you chew and swallow safely right now?

steps.detail: No tablets? Drink 150 mL of juice or regular soda.

steps.text: Eat a snack with starch and protein, then rest for an hour
steps.detail: For example crackers with peanut butter. It stops the sugar dropping again.

steps.text: Inject glucagon into your outer thigh
steps.detail: If you might pass out, lie on your side first.

steps.text: Lie on your side. Don't eat or drink until you are fully awake.
When you are fully awake: chew fast sugar, then eat a snack

escalation: Still low after fast sugar twice and glucagon: stay on your side, keep sipping juice only if you can swallow safely, and follow EMG-LOW-GLUCOSE. The crew and Earth were alerted when you started.
